## Checklist

- [ ] I verified the changed behavior and considered regressions.
- [ ] I added or updated JVM tests, or explained why they are not applicable.
- [ ] I added or updated instrumented tests, or explained why they are not applicable.
- [ ] I assessed Room schema or migration impact and updated migration tests when applicable.
- [ ] I verified reminder behavior, including scheduling, permissions, or notification effects when applicable.
- [ ] I checked accessibility, including content descriptions, semantics, focus, and text scaling where applicable.
- [ ] I checked localization and updated string resources where applicable.
- [ ] I attached screenshots for UI changes.
- [ ] I updated architecture documentation or confirmed it is not affected.
